notes.title: Update 07/11/2018
notes.content:
Edited the fire So that it starts with Max Fire to make it easy to start.

Fixed the Light so when the fire is close to dying youll have a better indication that is dying.

Added Difficulty so that the Fire and the Kids Get hard to maintain the Longer you play. 




Currently if the torch is in the fire it when the fire is close to dying the light indication gets bug so it looks like you die for no reason this is currently being worked on 

we will update once its fixed

notes.title: Update 07/05/2018
notes.content:
Leaderboards will now display cause of death when a new highscore is set.

Each now has a message that will display the cause of death.

Added flags for different countries.

Hexagon on the items you are holding will no longer display.

Fixed the Achivement that were not being called.
